items.title: Apollo’s Private-Equity Business Delivers Weak Results
items.summary: Apollo Global Management's private-equity division delivered weak results in the second quarter in contrast with some of its biggest rivals.  Private-capital giant Apollo reported $130 million in realized performance fees for the principal investing segment in the second quarter, down about 40% from a year prior.  The firm cited "monetization activity across certain flagship private equity and hybrid funds" as being "prudently delayed," a reference to a challenging environment for private-equity firms looking to exit investments.
